## Problem

What problem does this solve? One or two sentences.

## Proposed solution

What should router-core do that it does not do today?

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches were considered and why is this one better?

## Safety impact

This project is read-only by design. If your proposal would
introduce a write path, a new HTTP method, a new outbound
target, or relax any safety invariant, **stop and open an ADR
in `docs/adr/` first**. The ADR must be merged before the pull
request that implements the feature.

## Scope

- [ ] Adapter change
- [ ] Transport change
- [ ] Domain change
- [ ] New binary
- [ ] Documentation only

## Additional context

Links, screenshots, prior art, or related issues.
